items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson has been ruled out for Sunday night’s game in Atlanta due to ankle injury after missing all practice this week.
items.why: Ankle sprain; no practice Wed-Fri; coach ruled out.
items.implication: Tyler Huntley starts; Ravens pass game and rush threat downgraded significantly.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Zay Flowers, Mark Andrews, Isaiah Likely; Derrick Henry volume may rise in run-heavy script.

items.text: Commanders coach Dan Quinn says WR Stefon Diggs is out Sunday vs the Giants. Jayden Daniels is good to go, while WR Terry McLaurin is headed in a good direction.
items.why: Hamstring for Diggs; Daniels cleared; McLaurin progressing.
items.implication: Daniels full go boosts Commanders offense; Diggs absence opens targets.
items.opportunity: Elevated target share for remaining WRs/TEs; McLaurin potential return upgrades.

items.text: Jets have ruled out RB Breece Hall (quad) for Sunday’s game vs. the Browns.
items.implication: Second straight miss; backfield fully to backups.
items.opportunity: Lead role and high snap/touch share for remaining Jets RBs.

items.text: Eagles say DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Saquon Barkley (hamstring) did not practice again today; both week-to-week and unlikely for Week 5 vs Jaguars.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs on hamstrings; Rapoport notes unlikely to play.
items.implication: Eagles offense depleted; Hurts without key weapons.
items.opportunity: Backfield and WR targets to remaining players; Goedert if active.

items.text: Vikings are listing both WRs Jordan Addison (hamstring) and Justin Jefferson (ankle) as questionable for Sunday’s game vs. the Saints.
items.why: Ankle for Jefferson, hamstring for Addison; limited practices.
items.implication: Monitor Friday/Saturday; if either out, Hockenson and remaining WR surge.
items.opportunity: If OUT, massive target concentration on other pass-catchers.

items.text: No practice again today for WR Ladd McConkey (foot).
items.implication: Availability in doubt vs DEN; monitor final report.
items.opportunity: If out, targets to Quentin Johnston and others.

items.text: Love, love, LOVE Nico Collins against the Titans this week. I have Nico as my WR8.
items.why: Volume including red zone; Titans defense struggles vs WRs; strong recent usage post-return.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 start with upside in favorable matchup.

items.text: Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5 love; tied to Bengals injuries opening workload and soft matchup.
items.why: Workload hard to ignore; defenses carved up by RBs; Bengals WR injuries boost checkdowns/carries.
items.opportunity: Elevated carries, targets, red-zone if Chase/Higgins limited.

items.text: Isaiah Likely @ WSH as TE5 love; positional weakness and coverage matchup flagged.
items.why: TE matchup gift; volume potential especially with Lamar out.
items.implication: Strong TE1/stream start; boosted further by Jackson OUT.

items.text: First run of Week 5 projections live. DET-ARZ shaping up as one of the most popular DFS game stacks due to slate context (total 54.5, no other over 45.5) and pricing. Updates continuous.
items.why: Highest total by far; pricing makes stack attractive.
items.implication: High ceiling for DET/ARI pass catchers and skill players in fantasy/DFS.

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr aggravated his foot injury and coach said he'll miss multiple weeks. Pittman had been dealing with plantar fasciitis.
items.implication: Extended absence; Steelers WR corps thinner.
items.opportunity: Targets to DK Metcalf, Calvin Austin etc.

items.text: Jordan Addison @ NO hated as WR41; tough matchup, thin role, injury wrinkle, usage numbers poor.
items.conflict: If Jefferson out, role expands but Berry still fades.

items.text: Jalen Hurts vs JAX in London hated as QB15; rough stretch and banged-up line.
items.why: Recent struggles + OL issues + London + weapons out (Barkley/Smith).

items.text: Players with top-100 ADP missing significant time through 4 weeks include Chase, Nacua, Barkley, Jefferson, Collins, Bowers, AJ Brown, Smith, Hall, Flowers, Rice, Lamar, Etienne, McConkey, McLaurin, DJ Moore, Daniels, etc. Injury variance is massive factor in redraft/best ball/NFL; prepare with strong benches.
items.why: Data on missed games for high-ADP players; annual crush.
items.implication: Depth and handcuffs critical; variance explains many outcomes.
